summary: Enforce the cursor wire budget before returning continuation tokens
details: Include base64 expansion, separator and SHA-256 MAC bytes in the existing 4 KiB cursor limit, so successful encoding cannot return a token rejected by that same decoder for length.

Return the documented 409 projection conflict without partial output when dead-letter metadata cannot fit a continuation token, while preserving existing list-route error mappings and cursor format/bindings.

compatibility.notes: Valid existing cursors keep their format, signatures and bindings. Oversized encoder state now fails before an unusable token is returned. Only the new dead-letter route maps projection-cursor failure to its already documented 409; existing list routes retain their response mapping.

security: Cursor size checks remain bounded and authenticated tenant/resource/filter/order bindings are unchanged. Projection failure returns no metadata page or raw cursor state.
limitations: The cursor budget bounds representable continuation state; it does not promise a frozen queue view. Remaining EVY-1206 deployment/runbook work and full-ticket closure gates are pending.
